items_flat.title_en: US judge vacates Pentagon supply-chain risk label on Anthropic
items_flat.title_zh: 美國法官撤銷五角大廈對 Anthropic 的供應鏈風險標籤
items_flat.summary_en: US District Judge Rita Lin in San Francisco granted Anthropic summary judgment in part, vacating Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s February designation of the company as a national-security supply-chain risk and barring named agencies from enforcing the related boycott of military contractors doing business with Anthropic. Lin wrote that the measures were illegal and baseless retaliation for Anthropic’s public limits on surveillance and autonomous weapons, while affirming the Pentagon remains free not to buy Claude.
items_flat.summary_zh: 舊金山聯邦地方法官 Rita Lin 部分准許 Anthropic 簡易判決，撤銷國防部長 Pete Hegseth 今年二月將該公司列為國家安全供應鏈風險的決定，並禁止具名機關執行「軍方承包商不得與 Anthropic 往來」的抵制令。Lin 認為此舉是對 Anthropic 公開限制監控與自主武器用途的非法報復，同時確認五角大廈仍可自行選擇不採購 Claude。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the day’s highest-stakes lab story: it removes an unprecedented US-firm blacklist but does not force the Pentagon onto Claude. What changes next is whether an appeal stays the order and how other agencies treat Claude contracting.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是今日利害最大的實驗室新聞：它拿掉對美國公司前所未見的黑名單，但並未強迫五角大廈改用 Claude。下一步要看上訴是否暫停執行，以及其他機關如何處理 Claude 合約。
items_flat.quote: Though the Department of War is undisputedly free to select the AI vendor of its choice, the evidence demonstrates that the broad measures imposed on Anthropic were illegal and baseless.
items_flat.quote_zh: 戰爭部無疑可自由選擇其 AI 供應商，但證據顯示加諸 Anthropic 的廣泛措施既違法亦毫無根據。

items_flat.title_en: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with longer scene extension and 4K upscaling
items_flat.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash：更長場景延展與 4K 放大
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash for developer video generation and editing via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. The update extends scenes using up to 10 seconds of prior context (versus 1 second previously), in 10-second increments up to 40 seconds total, and adds first/last-frame interpolation, 360p drafts, video references, and upscaling to 1080p or 4K.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 透過 Gemini API 與 Google AI Studio 推出開發者影片生成與編輯模型 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash。更新可用最多 10 秒前段上下文延展場景（先前僅 1 秒），以 10 秒為單位累計至 40 秒，並新增首末幀插值、360p 草稿、影片參考與放大至 1080p 或 4K。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a controllability upgrade more than a new flagship: longer temporal memory and keyframe control matter for production workflows, but clip length remains short and quality claims still need independent comparison with Veo and rival video models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這比較像可控性升級而非新旗艦：更長時間記憶與關鍵幀控制對製作流程有用，但片段仍短，畫質主張尚待與 Veo 及其他影片模型獨立對照。
items_flat.quote: With Omni 1.1, the model can now analyze up to 10 seconds of prior context — a leap from previous models that only referenced the final second.
items_flat.quote_zh: Omni 1.1 現在可分析最多 10 秒先前上下文——相較以往模型只參考最後一秒，是大幅躍進。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind pilots double-blind evaluations for a proprietary Gemini model
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind 試點專有 Gemini 模型雙盲評測
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind said it is piloting what it calls the first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary frontier-class model, using Google Cloud Confidential Space so evaluators cannot see Gemini weights and Google cannot see test prompts. Partners include the Singapore AI Safety Institute, OpenMined, AVERI, and MLCommons, testing a Gemini Flash Lite model on confidential benchmarks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 表示正在試點其所謂首個對專有前沿級模型的雙盲評測，使用 Google Cloud Confidential Space，使評測方看不到 Gemini 權重、Google 看不到測試提示。合作方包括新加坡 AI 安全研究所、OpenMined、AVERI 與 MLCommons，以機密基準測試 Gemini Flash Lite。
items_flat.analysis_en: The method targets a real integrity problem—benchmark contamination—but this is a pilot on Flash Lite, not a flagship, and independent reproducibility outside Google Cloud’s confidential stack remains unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 方法對準基準污染這個真實誠信問題，但這是 Flash Lite 的試點而非旗艦，且在 Google Cloud 機密運算棧之外能否獨立重現仍未證實。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the world’s first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary, frontier class AI model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出全球首個針對專有前沿級 AI 模型的雙盲評測。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and 100+ firms call for a cyber-defense surge
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 與逾百家企業呼籲網路防禦總動員
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI posted that it and organizations including Anthropic, AWS, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle are calling for a global effort to give defenders tools and support before AI-enabled attacks become more widespread. The accompanying letter argues status-quo security will not be enough and urges leaders to treat cyber defense as an immediate priority.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發文表示，其與 Anthropic、AWS、Google、Microsoft、Oracle 等機構呼籲全球協力，在 AI 驅動攻擊更普及前把工具與支援交給防守方。公開信主張現狀資安不足，並敦促領導人把網路防禦列為立即優先事項。
items_flat.analysis_en: The letter is coordinated industry messaging after a summer of agent-related security incidents, not a new product or binding policy. What changes depends on whether labs actually ship defender tools and governments fund deployment.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是歷經今夏代理相關資安事件後的產業協同表態，不是新產品或具約束力政策。真正改變取決於實驗室是否交出防守工具、政府是否出資部署。
items_flat.quote: We have a limited window to strengthen cyber defenses, and together with organizations including Anthropic, AWS, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle, we're calling for a global effort to give defenders the tools, resources, and support to protect the infrastructure we all depend on.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們強化網路防禦的窗口有限；我們與 Anthropic、AWS、Google、Microsoft、Oracle 等機構一道，呼籲全球協力把工具、資源與支援交給防守方，保護大家依賴的基礎設施。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic previews Model Hardware Standard for agents on lab equipment
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 預覽 Model Hardware Standard：讓代理操作實驗室設備
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to operate physical devices such as microscopes, liquid handlers, and robotic arms. It said MHS is model-agnostic, works with any programmable interface and MCP, and will be shared with science and manufacturing partners to build safety evaluations before open-sourcing.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是讓 AI 代理操作顯微鏡、液體處理器與機械臂等實體裝置的共用規格。公司表示 MHS 與模型無關，適用任何可程式介面與 MCP，並將先與科學及製造夥伴共建安全評測，再開源。
items_flat.analysis_en: The announcement is a protocol preview, not a demonstration that Claude can already run unsupervised wet labs. Safety evaluations and partner uptake will decide whether this becomes infrastructure or a narrow research tool.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是協定預覽，並非證明 Claude 已能無人監督地跑濕實驗室。安全評測與夥伴採用，將決定它成為基礎設施或只是狹窄研究工具。
items_flat.quote: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們向第一批科學研究實驗室與先進製造商開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是讓 AI 代理安全操作實體裝置的共用規格。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens 10,000 discounted Claude seats for scientists
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 為科學家開放 1 萬個優惠 Claude 席次
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic said it is opening 10,000 seats for principal investigators at academic or nonprofit labs to get Claude team-plan access for one year: standard seats free, premium seats with 5x usage limits at $15 a month. It is also widening AI for Science credits beyond biology, while keeping Fable models blocked on professional biology queries.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示將為學術或非營利實驗室主持人開放 1 萬個席次，一年內使用 Claude 團隊方案：標準席免費，5 倍用量高級席每月 15 美元。同時把 AI for Science 點數擴大到生物學以外，但 Fable 模型仍封鎖專業生物學查詢。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is distribution and community-building, not a new model. Dual-use limits on biology remain the binding constraint for the highest-stakes lab work.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是通路與社群經營，不是新模型。生物學兩用限制，仍是最高風險實驗室工作的硬約束。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, we are announcing a significant expansion of these efforts. We are opening 10,000 seats for scientists around the world to access Claude subscriptions for free and at discounted rates for one year.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起我們宣布大幅擴展這些計畫，向全球科學家開放 1 萬個席次，一年內免費或折扣使用 Claude 訂閱。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Ads on Free and Go tiers in India
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在印度對 Free 與 Go 方案推出 ChatGPT 廣告
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said ChatGPT Ads are rolling out in India to logged-in adults on Free and Go plans, with ads labelled and placed below responses; Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Education, and under-18 accounts stay ad-free. It named WPP and Omnicom as first agency partners, said more than 50 brands will go live this week, and set a self-serve Ads Manager for September 4 with daily budgets from ₹725.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示 ChatGPT 廣告在印度向已登入成人 Free 與 Go 用戶推出，廣告標示並放在回覆下方；Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise、Education 與未滿 18 歲帳號維持無廣告。首批代理為 WPP 與 Omnicom，逾 50 個品牌本週上線，9 月 4 日開放自助 Ads Manager，每日預算起跳 725 盧比。
items_flat.analysis_en: India is a scale monetization test after earlier ads experiments elsewhere. Trust hinges on whether sponsored placements stay visually separate from answers as promised.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 印度是先前其他市場廣告實驗後的規模變現測試。信任取決於贊助版位是否如承諾與答案視覺分離。
items_flat.quote: With ChatGPT Ads, businesses of every size can introduce themselves at relevant, high-context moments when decisions are beginning to take shape.
items_flat.quote_zh: 透過 ChatGPT Ads，各種規模的企業都能在決策成形、高情境相關的時刻介紹自己。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches commercial operations in Brazil
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 在巴西啟動商業營運
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced commercial operations based in São Paulo, saying Brazil is one of ChatGPT’s three largest markets by weekly active users, with about 215 million messages a day and nearly doubled users over the past year. It said Brazil ranks second globally by OpenAI API developers and that Enterprise seats there have grown fivefold year over year.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布以聖保羅為據點啟動商業營運，稱巴西是 ChatGPT 週活躍用戶前三大市場之一，每日約 2.15 億則訊息，過去一年用戶近乎翻倍。公司表示巴西 OpenAI API 開發者數全球第二，當地 Enterprise 席次年增五倍。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is market-buildout, not a model launch: OpenAI is converting already-high consumer usage into a local sales, education, and public-sector footprint.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是市場深耕而非模型發布：OpenAI 要把已經很高的消費端使用，轉成在地銷售、教育與公部門據點。
items_flat.quote: Brazil is one of ChatGPT’s three largest markets by weekly active users. The number of users in the country has nearly doubled over the past year, and people in Brazil now send approximately 215 million messages to ChatGPT each day.
items_flat.quote_zh: 以週活躍用戶計，巴西是 ChatGPT 三大市場之一。過去一年用戶數近乎翻倍，巴西用戶每天向 ChatGPT 發送約 2.15 億則訊息。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI study: ChatGPT plus critical-thinking training changes student work differently
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 研究：ChatGPT 加上批判思考訓練對學生作業影響不同
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published a company study reporting that ChatGPT access improved the quality and coherence of students’ answers on a five-point rubric by almost a full point, while a causal-reasoning exercise led students to generate a wider range of distinct ideas. Students who received both showed both effects.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 發表公司研究，稱取得 ChatGPT 後學生答案在五分量表上的品質與連貫性幾乎提高一分；因果推理練習則讓學生產生更廣泛、彼此相異的想法。兩者兼得的學生同時呈現兩種效果。
items_flat.analysis_en: The finding is useful as a product-education narrative, but it is an OpenAI-authored study, so independence and generalizability are limited until methods, sample, and task design are independently replicated.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 作為產品教育敘事有用，但這是 OpenAI 自撰研究，在方法、樣本與任務設計被獨立重現前，獨立性與可推論性有限。
items_flat.quote: AI helped students make their answers better. Critical-thinking training helped make their ideas broader.
items_flat.quote_zh: AI 幫助學生把答案做得更好。批判思考訓練幫助他們把想法變得更廣。

items_flat.title_en: Google and Khan Academy ship Gemini-built classroom tools for the new school year
items_flat.title_zh: Google 與可汗學院為新學年推出 Gemini 課堂工具
items_flat.summary_en: Google said new Khanmigo features built with Gemini are launching for the school year: interactive diagrams that walk students through math and science concepts, and a teacher-controlled practice tool. Teachers can have Gemini draft practice questions from uploaded materials, then review, edit, or reject items before students see them.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 表示與 Gemini 打造的新 Khanmigo 功能於新學年推出：可帶學生走過數理概念的互動圖表，以及教師可控的練習工具。教師可讓 Gemini 依上傳教材草擬練習題，再審閱、修改或否決後才給學生。
items_flat.analysis_en: The product change is teacher-gated practice plus visual tutoring, not an unconstrained student chatbot. Impact depends on classroom uptake and whether teacher review actually prevents low-quality or off-curriculum items.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 產品變化是教師把關的練習加上視覺輔導，不是不受限的學生聊天機器人。影響取決於課堂採用，以及教師審核能否真正擋下低品質或偏離課綱的題目。
items_flat.quote: The latest version now enables teachers to partner with Gemini to plan, draft, and validate practice questions before students see them.
items_flat.quote_zh: 最新版本讓教師能與 Gemini 合作規劃、草擬並驗證練習題，再讓學生看到。

Lin wrote that the measures were illegal and baseless retaliation for Anthropic’s public limits on surveillance and autonomous weapons, while affirming the Pentagon remains free not to buy Claude.
anthropic.summary_zh: 舊金山聯邦地方法官 Rita Lin 部分准許 Anthropic 簡易判決，撤銷國防部長 Pete Hegseth 今年二月將該公司列為國家安全供應鏈風險的決定，並禁止具名機關執行「軍方承包商不得與 Anthropic 往來」的抵制令。Lin 認為此舉是對 Anthropic 公開限制監控與自主武器用途的非法報復，同時確認五角大廈仍可自行選擇不採購 Claude。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the day’s highest-stakes lab story: it removes an unprecedented US-firm blacklist but does not force the Pentagon onto Claude. What changes next is whether an appeal stays the order and how other agencies treat Claude contracting.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是今日利害最大的實驗室新聞：它拿掉對美國公司前所未見的黑名單，但並未強迫五角大廈改用 Claude。下一步要看上訴是否暫停執行，以及其他機關如何處理 Claude 合約。
anthropic.quote: Though the Department of War is undisputedly free to select the AI vendor of its choice, the evidence demonstrates that the broad measures imposed on Anthropic were illegal and baseless.
anthropic.quote_zh: 戰爭部無疑可自由選擇其 AI 供應商，但證據顯示加諸 Anthropic 的廣泛措施既違法亦毫無根據。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic previews Model Hardware Standard for agents on lab equipment
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 預覽 Model Hardware Standard：讓代理操作實驗室設備
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic opened a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to operate physical devices such as microscopes, liquid handlers, and robotic arms. It said MHS is model-agnostic, works with any programmable interface and MCP, and will be shared with science and manufacturing partners to build safety evaluations before open-sourcing.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是讓 AI 代理操作顯微鏡、液體處理器與機械臂等實體裝置的共用規格。公司表示 MHS 與模型無關，適用任何可程式介面與 MCP，並將先與科學及製造夥伴共建安全評測，再開源。
anthropic.analysis_en: The announcement is a protocol preview, not a demonstration that Claude can already run unsupervised wet labs. Safety evaluations and partner uptake will decide whether this becomes infrastructure or a narrow research tool.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是協定預覽，並非證明 Claude 已能無人監督地跑濕實驗室。安全評測與夥伴採用，將決定它成為基礎設施或只是狹窄研究工具。
anthropic.quote: We’re opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們向第一批科學研究實驗室與先進製造商開放 Model Hardware Standard（MHS）研究預覽，這是讓 AI 代理安全操作實體裝置的共用規格。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic opens 10,000 discounted Claude seats for scientists
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 為科學家開放 1 萬個優惠 Claude 席次
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic said it is opening 10,000 seats for principal investigators at academic or nonprofit labs to get Claude team-plan access for one year: standard seats free, premium seats with 5x usage limits at $15 a month. It is also widening AI for Science credits beyond biology, while keeping Fable models blocked on professional biology queries.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示將為學術或非營利實驗室主持人開放 1 萬個席次，一年內使用 Claude 團隊方案：標準席免費，5 倍用量高級席每月 15 美元。同時把 AI for Science 點數擴大到生物學以外，但 Fable 模型仍封鎖專業生物學查詢。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is distribution and community-building, not a new model. Dual-use limits on biology remain the binding constraint for the highest-stakes lab work.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是通路與社群經營，不是新模型。生物學兩用限制，仍是最高風險實驗室工作的硬約束。
anthropic.quote: Starting today, we are announcing a significant expansion of these efforts. We are opening 10,000 seats for scientists around the world to access Claude subscriptions for free and at discounted rates for one year.
anthropic.quote_zh: 即日起我們宣布大幅擴展這些計畫，向全球科學家開放 1 萬個席次，一年內免費或折扣使用 Claude 訂閱。

google.title_en: Google ships Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with longer scene extension and 4K upscaling
google.title_zh: Google 推出 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash：更長場景延展與 4K 放大
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash for developer video generation and editing via the Gemini API and Google AI Studio. The update extends scenes using up to 10 seconds of prior context (versus 1 second previously), in 10-second increments up to 40 seconds total, and adds first/last-frame interpolation, 360p drafts, video references, and upscaling to 1080p or 4K.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 透過 Gemini API 與 Google AI Studio 推出開發者影片生成與編輯模型 Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash。更新可用最多 10 秒前段上下文延展場景（先前僅 1 秒），以 10 秒為單位累計至 40 秒，並新增首末幀插值、360p 草稿、影片參考與放大至 1080p 或 4K。
google.analysis_en: This is a controllability upgrade more than a new flagship: longer temporal memory and keyframe control matter for production workflows, but clip length remains short and quality claims still need independent comparison with Veo and rival video models.
google.analysis_zh: 這比較像可控性升級而非新旗艦：更長時間記憶與關鍵幀控制對製作流程有用，但片段仍短，畫質主張尚待與 Veo 及其他影片模型獨立對照。
google.quote: With Omni 1.1, the model can now analyze up to 10 seconds of prior context — a leap from previous models that only referenced the final second.
google.quote_zh: Omni 1.1 現在可分析最多 10 秒先前上下文——相較以往模型只參考最後一秒，是大幅躍進。

google.title_en: DeepMind pilots double-blind evaluations for a proprietary Gemini model
google.title_zh: DeepMind 試點專有 Gemini 模型雙盲評測
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind said it is piloting what it calls the first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary frontier-class model, using Google Cloud Confidential Space so evaluators cannot see Gemini weights and Google cannot see test prompts. Partners include the Singapore AI Safety Institute, OpenMined, AVERI, and MLCommons, testing a Gemini Flash Lite model on confidential benchmarks.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 表示正在試點其所謂首個對專有前沿級模型的雙盲評測，使用 Google Cloud Confidential Space，使評測方看不到 Gemini 權重、Google 看不到測試提示。合作方包括新加坡 AI 安全研究所、OpenMined、AVERI 與 MLCommons，以機密基準測試 Gemini Flash Lite。
google.analysis_en: The method targets a real integrity problem—benchmark contamination—but this is a pilot on Flash Lite, not a flagship, and independent reproducibility outside Google Cloud’s confidential stack remains unproven.
google.analysis_zh: 方法對準基準污染這個真實誠信問題，但這是 Flash Lite 的試點而非旗艦，且在 Google Cloud 機密運算棧之外能否獨立重現仍未證實。
google.quote: Today, we’re introducing the world’s first double-blind evaluation of a proprietary, frontier class AI model.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出全球首個針對專有前沿級 AI 模型的雙盲評測。

google.title_en: Google and Khan Academy ship Gemini-built classroom tools for the new school year
google.title_zh: Google 與可汗學院為新學年推出 Gemini 課堂工具
google.summary_en: Google said new Khanmigo features built with Gemini are launching for the school year: interactive diagrams that walk students through math and science concepts, and a teacher-controlled practice tool. Teachers can have Gemini draft practice questions from uploaded materials, then review, edit, or reject items before students see them.
google.summary_zh: Google 表示與 Gemini 打造的新 Khanmigo 功能於新學年推出：可帶學生走過數理概念的互動圖表，以及教師可控的練習工具。教師可讓 Gemini 依上傳教材草擬練習題，再審閱、修改或否決後才給學生。
google.analysis_en: The product change is teacher-gated practice plus visual tutoring, not an unconstrained student chatbot. Impact depends on classroom uptake and whether teacher review actually prevents low-quality or off-curriculum items.
google.analysis_zh: 產品變化是教師把關的練習加上視覺輔導，不是不受限的學生聊天機器人。影響取決於課堂採用，以及教師審核能否真正擋下低品質或偏離課綱的題目。
google.quote: The latest version now enables teachers to partner with Gemini to plan, draft, and validate practice questions before students see them.
google.quote_zh: 最新版本讓教師能與 Gemini 合作規劃、草擬並驗證練習題，再讓學生看到。

brief_en: A San Francisco judge vacated the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label on Anthropic. Google shipped Omni 1.1 Flash video controls and a double-blind eval pilot. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and 100+ firms urged a cyber-defense surge. Anthropic previewed a hardware-agent standard and 10k scientist seats; OpenAI pushed ads in India and a Brazil office.
brief_zh: 舊金山法官撤銷五角大廈對 Anthropic 的供應鏈風險標籤。Google 推出 Omni 1.1 Flash 影片控制與雙盲評測試點。OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等逾百家企業呼籲網路防禦總動員。Anthropic 預覽硬體代理標準並開放萬席科學家方案；OpenAI 在印度上廣告、在巴西設商業營運。
